description: This file defines a Kotlin data class and a composable function for managing and displaying Base64-encoded images within an Android app using Jetpack Compose. It handles decoding a Base64 string into an ImageBitmap, manages state, and indicates loading failure.

classes.name: Base64ImageState
classes.description: A data class holding an optional ImageBitmap and a Boolean flag indicating if image decoding failed.

methods.name: rememberBase64ImageState
methods.description: A composable function that initializes and manages the state for a Base64-encoded image, decoding it asynchronously and tracking failure.
